metadata.description:
Solid freshman year Valentine’s Day episode with mostly non-corny music. Chevy is in the studio as cohost. Also, Sye calls in to defend himself against “Revenge of the Funky Man.”

(tape 017)

Side A

  • Intro Airbreak
  • Si We… (Charged For Murder) (feat. Junior Reid & Ninjaman)… Snow
  • Do You Understand?… B-Versatile
  • Sound of the Police… KRS-One
  • Fat Cats, Bigga Fish… The Coup
  • Ruffian… Charlie Chaplin
  • Wu-Tang Clan Ain’t Nothin’ to Fuck With… Wu-Tang Clan
  • Airbreak
  • Shakiyla… Poor Righteous Teachers
  • Passin’ Me By… The Pharcyde
  • All I Need… Method Man
  • Girls I Got ‘Em Locked… Superlover Cee & Casanova Rud

Side B

  • Girls I Got ‘Em Locked… Superlover Cee & Casanova Rud (rest)
  • Squeeze Me… Macka B
  • Love is da Shit… Spearhead
  • Airbreak
  • Action (feat. Nadine Sutherland)… Terror Fabulous (request)
  • Pianist… General Degree
  • One in a Million (live)… Half Pint
  • Bedroom Bully… Shabba Ranks (request)
  • Intro… Laze
  • Monkey See, Monkey Do… Laze
  • Come Widdit… Ahmad, Ras Kass, & Saafir
  • Roll With Da Flavor (Remix)… Flavor Unit MC’s
  • The Adventures of Grandmaster Flash On the Wheels of Steel… Grandmaster Flash & The Furious Five

Side C

  • Revenge of the Funky Man (feat. Mista Midnight)… Laze
  • Disneyland… Snoman
  • Slow Love… Prince
  • Airbreak
  • Day of Outrage (Operation Snatchback)… X-Clan
  • Airbreak
  • Giving/Sharing… Half Pint
  • U Will Know… Black Men United
  • Airbreak
  • Sensitivity… Ralph Tresvant
  • Closing Airbreak
  • National Anthem
